source: docs/design/proposals/2026-11-melee-techniques.md and 2026-11-ranged-techniques.md (Physical 2.0, rules 1.12); every number is provisional

props.point: It thrusts. Typical riders: to-hit, armour ignored, pinning.
props.blunt: It crushes. Typical riders: Prone, Dazed, armour broken.
props.hook: It catches. Typical riders: pull, trip, disarm.
props.heavy: Mass. Melee: 3 AP an attack, knockback, hitting several. Ranged: must be Braced to work well.
props.light: Fast. 2 AP an attack; extra steps and strikes.
props.bare: A fist or a glove. Grapples and throws.
props.quick: Handy. Firing next to an enemy doesn't provoke; moving costs no accuracy.
props.auto: Throws many rounds. Pressure on a miss; several targets. Always offers Burst and Rake.
props.precise: A long barrel or glass. Better when you haven't moved; criticals.
props.spread: Shot or flame in a cone. Everyone close; breaks cover.
props.blast: It explodes. Aimed at a tile; Pressure to everyone in the radius.
props.silent: No report. Never reveals you; no Pressure on a miss, more on a hit from unseen; its pips are hidden.
props.loud: A cannon in the hand. A miss still gives Pressure; saves against it are harder.
props.drawn: Your arm is the powder. No Heat or Recoil; a quiver, not a magazine; it can't be reloaded in a fight.

items.name: Lunge
items.text: Step 1 tile toward the target, then strike. The step draws no opportunity attack.

lines.text: on a hit the target is pushed 1 tile.

items.name: Charge
items.text: After moving 3 or more tiles in a straight line this turn: strike at +10% damage per tile moved, up to +50%.

lines.text: the target makes a Body save or falls Prone.
you strike before it can take its Overwatch or Keep Back.

items.name: Feint
items.text: No damage. The target makes a Brain save against your Brain debuff strength. If it fails, your next technique against it this turn has +3 to hit and it can't use an Answer. Counts as a hit for Momentum when it works.

lines.text: on a failed save its weapon is also lowered (1 AP to raise).

items.name: Draw Cut
items.text: Draw this weapon from the pack or a sheath and strike in one action. Only if you started the turn with it stowed.

lines.text: if the target hasn't acted this fight, it counts as an ambush.

items.name: Ambush
items.text: Only from Hidden: strike with the Ambush multiplier (today's rule), and gain 2 Momentum instead of 1.

lines.text: no damage, the target is Grappled and Silenced for 1 round instead.

items.name: Cut
items.text: One strike. Everyone knows it; it never takes a ready slot.

items.name: Sweep
items.text: Strike up to 3 enemies in an arc in front of you, each at ×0.7, one roll each.

lines.text: all adjacent enemies, not just the arc.
each one hit bleeds on a critical. Friendly fire applies.

items.name: Bash
items.text: Strike at ×0.5 with the pommel, haft or fist. The target makes a Body save or is Dazed.

lines.text: on a failed save it is pushed 2 tiles instead of Dazed, your choice.

items.name: Sunder
items.text: Strike at ×0.7. On a hit the target's armour is 5 lower for the rest of the fight (once per target per attacker).

lines.text: if the target has no armour left, Bleeding instead.

items.name: Flurry
items.text: Two strikes at ×0.6 at one target, the second at −1 to hit. Momentum for each that hits.

lines.text: each hit after the first adds +1 to the next Bind or Throw Down this turn.
the strikes may go to two targets in throwing range; the weapons land in the pile on their tiles.

items.name: Hamstring
items.text: Strike at ×0.7. The target makes a Body save or is Slowed 2 rounds.

lines.text: it also can't Sprint or Disengage while Slowed.

items.name: Bind
items.text: No damage. Lock the target's weapon with yours: until your next turn it attacks anyone but you at −2 and can't move away without a Body save. You can't use Reach while binding.

lines.text: Brain save or it is Disarmed.

items.name: Half-Sword
items.text: A short, driven thrust: ×0.8 damage, ignores 10 armour.

items.name: Throw
items.text: Throw the weapon at a target in throwing range (Dexterity to hit). It lands in the pile on the target's tile.

lines.text: no penalty and full damage. Without Thrown: −2 to hit, ×0.7.
the target makes a Body save or is knocked Prone.

items.name: Sidestep
items.text: Move 1 tile to another tile next to the same enemy. No opportunity attack. Your next Strike against it this turn ignores a carried shield and counts as flanking.

items.name: Guard
items.text: +2 Defense against melee until your next turn, and your Momentum doesn't drop at the end of this turn.

lines.text: enemies must make a Body save to step next to you.
the +2 also applies to ranged attacks from the front.

items.name: Shove
items.text: Today's Shove (push 1 tile, or Prone if blocked), at 1 AP as a Link. It gives Momentum when it works.

items.name: Trip
items.text: The target makes a Body save or falls Prone.

lines.text: you may go Prone with it and it is Grappled.

items.name: Drag
items.text: Pull an adjacent or reached target 1 tile toward you, or swap tiles with it (Body save).

lines.text: 2 tiles, and from 2 tiles away with Reach.
you may move 1 tile and bring it with you.

items.name: Coup
items.text: One strike at +25% damage per Momentum spent. (This is the Fighter's Finisher, opened to everyone; see section 6.)

lines.text: +50% more against a target that is Bleeding, Dazed, Prone or Downed.
a hit is a critical if the target is at a quarter HP or less.

items.name: Cleave
items.text: One strike; then the same strike at one more adjacent enemy per Momentum spent, each at full damage.

lines.text: the extra targets may be 2 tiles apart.

items.name: Break
items.text: One strike. The target makes a Body save at −1 per Momentum spent or is Stunned (bosses: Dazed).

lines.text: its armour is also 0 for a round.

items.name: Run Through
items.text: One strike at +20% per Momentum spent. On a hit the target is Pinned where it stands until it spends 2 AP to pull free.

lines.text: ignores armour, and if a second enemy stands directly behind the first it is struck at half.
you may leave the weapon in (you are unarmed; the target stays Pinned until someone pulls it out for 2 AP). Without Point: −2 to hit.

items.name: Throw Down
items.text: Only on a target you have Grappled or Bound: slam it into a tile next to you. Damage ×1 + 25% per Momentum, Prone, and the grapple ends. Anyone on that tile is struck at half and must save or fall Prone.

items.name: Parry
items.text: Roll your attack skill against the attacker's total. If you win, the hit is halved.

lines.text: you may parry for an adjacent ally. A shield in the off hand adds +2.

items.name: Riposte
items.text: Strike back for 0 AP (today's Sabre skill and Fighter move).

items.name: Keep Back
items.text: Strike it first. If you hit, it makes a Body save or stops where it is.
items.trigger: an enemy steps into your reach

lines.text: your reach is 2 tiles, so most enemies never arrive.
on a failed save it is also Prone.

items.name: Shot
items.text: One shot. Everyone knows it; it takes no ready slot.

lines.text: +1 if you haven't moved this turn.

items.name: Snap Shot
items.text: Draw or swap to this weapon and fire, at −2.

items.name: Burst
items.text: Two rolls at one target, the second at −2.

lines.text: three rolls (today's burst), and it may split between two adjacent targets.

items.name: Aimed Shot
items.text: +2 to hit (today's rule).

lines.text: +3, and a critical on 18–20 if you haven't moved.

items.name: Called Shot
items.text: −2 to hit. Choose leg (Slowed), arm (weapon lowered) or head (Dazed); the target makes a Body save.

items.name: Walking Fire
items.text: Move 2 tiles and fire one shot at any point of the move.

lines.text: the shot is a Burst for 3 rounds.

items.name: Punch Through
items.text: Half cover counts −2, not −5, and the cover takes the damage as well.

lines.text: the round carries on to the next target in line at half.

items.name: Lob
items.text: Fire at a target only an ally can see (through smoke or dark), at −4.

lines.text: you aim at the tile; no penalty, and everyone in the radius gains +2 Pressure.

items.name: Suppress
items.text: One roll at +2. A hit is half damage and +2 Pressure; a miss is +1.

lines.text: enemies within 1 tile of the target also gain +1.
it holds until your next turn: any enemy that moves or fires inside 3 tiles of the target gains +1 (today's Suppressing Fire).

items.name: Rake
items.text: Up to 3 targets within 2 tiles of each other, each at −3; +1 Pressure on a hit.

lines.text: today's full-auto cone for 10 rounds; +1 Pressure hit or miss.

items.name: Warning Shot
items.text: No attack. The target makes a Heart save or gains +1 Pressure.

items.name: Flush
items.text: Hit the target's cover (no roll; the cover takes the damage). The target gains +2 Pressure.

lines.text: the cover is ignored and the target takes half damage as well.

items.name: Mag Dump
items.text: Empty the weapon at one target: one roll per 3 rounds left (at most 4 rolls), each at −1 more than the last. +1 Pressure per hit. Heat goes to one under the limit.

lines.text: +1 Pressure per roll, hit or miss.
both barrels, one roll at double damage within 4 tiles.

items.name: Crossfire
items.text: A shot at a target an ally has already hit this round: +2 to hit and +1 extra Pressure.

lines.text: step 1 tile first, with no opportunity attack.

items.name: Bead
items.text: Name a target. Until you move or name another, your shots at it ignore one range band, and its Pressure doesn't fall while you see it.

lines.text: you may move 1 tile without losing it.

items.name: Spot
items.text: Name a target for the squad: until your next turn allies have +1 to hit it, and the first ally to hit it adds +1 Pressure more.

lines.text: allies also ignore one range band.

items.name: Brace
items.text: Today's Brace, opened to any weapon resting on half cover: Recoil halved.

items.name: Load Special
items.text: Chamber one special round you carry (armour-piercing, hollow-point, incendiary, enhanced) for your next Fire. The magazine stays as it is.

lines.text: the whole cone gets the round's rider.

items.name: Shift
items.text: Move 1 tile from cover to cover without setting off a Watch.

items.name: Vent
items.text: −2 Heat now.

items.name: Head Down
items.text: Remove 1 Pressure from yourself, 2 behind full cover. You can't Watch this round.

items.name: Dead Centre
items.text: One shot at +50% damage.

items.name: Pin Down
items.text: A shot at ×0.7. On a hit the target saves (Guts or Athletics, whichever is better) or is Pinned (today's condition) for 1 round.

lines.text: nailed in place until it spends 2 AP.

items.name: Rout
items.text: No damage. The target makes a Heart save or runs its full move away from you, drawing opportunity attacks and Watches.

items.name: Stopping Shot
items.text: A shot. On a hit the target saves (Guts or Athletics, whichever is better) or loses 1 AP next turn and is pushed 1 tile.
items.suppressed: It also falls Prone on a failed save.

items.name: Storm
items.text: Move up to 3 tiles toward the target without its reaction, then shoot.
items.suppressed: Your shot is a critical on 18–20.

items.name: Last Round
items.text: Only with the last round in the weapon: +3 to hit. If it takes the target out, your next speed reload is free.
items.suppressed: It can't be reduced by cover.

lines.text: the last arrow in the quiver counts.

items.name: Overwatch
items.trigger: the first enemy to move in your sight (today's rule, unchanged)
items.text: the held shot

items.name: Deny
items.trigger: the first enemy to enter a tile you name
items.text: the shot; on a hit it stops there

lines.text: any tile in a straight line of 3.

items.name: Cover Me
items.trigger: the first enemy to attack an ally you name
items.text: that attack is at −2, and the enemy gains +1 Pressure

items.name: Dead to Rights
items.trigger: a Pressed enemy you name attacks, stands up, reloads or leaves cover
items.text: the shot lands first, at +2
